# Frozen Go API — package queue
# Generated by TestFrozenGoAPIMatchesBaseline. Do not edit by hand.
# See API-COMPATIBILITY.md; a diff here is a contract change.

type CommandProcessor interface {
	Append(context.Context, AppendCommand) (AppendOutcome, error)
	Consume(context.Context, ConsumeCommand) (ConsumeOutcome, error)
	CommitConsume(context.Context, CommitConsumeCommand) error
	Ack(context.Context, AckCommand) (SettlementOutcome, error)
	Nack(context.Context, NackCommand) (SettlementOutcome, error)
	Reject(context.Context, RejectCommand) (SettlementOutcome, error)
	Claim(context.Context, ClaimCommand) (ClaimOutcome, error)
	Seek(context.Context, SeekCommand) (SeekOutcome, error)
}

type OffsetCommitter interface {
	CommitOffset(context.Context, CommitOffsetCommand) error
}

type AppendCommand struct {
	QueueName		string
	Messages		[]types.PublishRequest
	AtomicBatch		bool
	RequireProtectedDurable	bool
}

type AppendOutcome struct {
	FirstOffset	uint64
	LastOffset	uint64
	Count		uint32
	Timestamp	time.Time
}

type ConsumeCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	ConsumerID	string
	Filter		string
	Limit		int
}

type ConsumeOutcome struct {
	Messages	[]*message.Envelope
	Mode		types.ConsumerGroupMode
	NextOffset	uint64
	CommitRequired	bool
}

type CommitConsumeCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	Offset		uint64
}

type CommitOffsetCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	Offset		uint64
}

type AckCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	ConsumerID	string
	Offsets		[]uint64
}

type NackCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	ConsumerID	string
	Offsets		[]uint64
	Delay		time.Duration
}

type RejectCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	ConsumerID	string
	Offsets		[]uint64
	Reason		string
}

type SettlementOutcome struct {
	Offsets		[]uint64
	Cursor		uint64
	Committed	uint64
}

type ClaimCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	GroupID		string
	ConsumerID	string
	MinIdle		time.Duration
	Limit		int
}

type ClaimOutcome struct {
	Messages	[]*message.Envelope
	Offsets		[]uint64
}

type SeekKind string
	const SeekOffset = "offset"
	const SeekTimestamp = "timestamp"

type SeekCommand struct {
	QueueName	string
	Kind		SeekKind
	Offset		uint64
	Timestamp	time.Time
}

type SeekOutcome struct {
	Offset		uint64
	Timestamp	time.Time
	ExactMatch	bool
}
